correctness.rationale: For a genus-19 invariant curve F with quotient genus6 under C3, invariant holomorphic differentials have d0=6 and d1+d2=13. Holomorphic Lefschetz for exactly three points with tangent multiplier omega^2 yields 1-conj(tr_H10)=3/(1-omega^2)=1-omega; hence tr_H10=omega^2. Since tr=6+d1*omega+d2*omega^2 and omega^2=-1-omega, this gives d1=6,d2=7. Complex-conjugate H01 contributes eigenvalue multiplicities (6,7,6), so H1 multiplicities (12,13,13), characteristic polynomial (t-1)^12(t²+t+1)^13. Its degree 38 and trace -1 agree with genus and ordinary Lefschetz; Riemann–Hurwitz: 36=3*10+3*2, checks quotient genus. Prym dimension=19-6=13, Hodge multiplicities 6/7. This is an exact symbolic argument conditional on quoted generator/local-multiplier convention, not an invented verification of the unavailable primary passage.
